overloads.semanticRole: The VP ADD RANGE NAME command creates or modifies a named range in the open document.

constraints: If name is already used within the same scope, the new named range replaces the existing one; the same name can be reused across different scopes.
options.scope selects the sheet index (0-based) the name is local to, or the vk workbook constant to make it global to the whole document; vk current sheet scopes it to whichever sheet is current.
